Appliance Error Code Guide / PF

PFLG

LG top-load washer PF

Context

Power was interrupted during the previous operation.

Checks

  1. Check whether the message coincides with a recent power interruption.
  2. If no unsafe condition is present, consult the manual for resuming after an interruption.

Next action

If it repeats without an outage or power is unstable, stop retrying and contact LG official service; do not inspect wiring yourself.

Sources

  • LG US — top-load washer error code list ↗
